script.opening_words:
Most people think living on $30,000 or
less is impossible in today's economy.
They imagine surviving on ramen noodles,
wearing the same three shirts for
months, and basically living like a
college student forever. But what if I
told you that's completely wrong? What
if I told you that with the right
strategies, you could not only survive,
but actually thrive on an extremely low
income while still enjoying the things
that matter most to you. My name is Nick
and I've spent years helping people
